facts: members earn 1 point for every dollar spent

loyalty-program.text: Trail Rewards members earn 1 point for every dollar spent. 500 points can be redeemed for a 5 dollar reward. Points expire after 12 months of account inactivity. Membership is free and points are earned automatically when signed in at checkout.
loyalty-program.title: Trail Rewards loyalty program

facts: a reset link is emailed within 10 minutes
reset links expire after 24 hours
accounts are locked after 5 failed sign in attempts
locked accounts unlock automatically after 30 minutes
password-reset.text: To reset a forgotten password, choose Forgot password on the sign in page and a reset link is emailed within 10 minutes. Reset links expire after 24 hours. Accounts are locked after 5 failed sign in attempts and unlock automatically after 30 minutes.
password-reset.title: Resetting your password

facts: a lower price found within 14 days of purchase qualifies for a price match
the difference is refunded to the original payment method
the item must be in stock at the competitor
price-match.text: If a lower price for the identical item is found at a major retailer within 14 days of purchase, the difference is refunded to the original payment method. Price match requests must include a link to the competitor listing and the item must be in stock at the competitor.
price-match.title: Price match guarantee

facts: return any unused item within 30 days of delivery
full refund to the original payment method
refunds are issued within 5 business days after the returned item is received
items must be in original packaging
final sale items cannot be returned
returns-policy.text: Customers can return any unused item within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Items must be in original packaging. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days after the returned item is received at the warehouse. Sale items marked final sale cannot be returned.
returns-policy.title: Returns and refunds policy

facts: standard shipping is free for orders over 50 dollars
standard shipping otherwise costs 4.95 dollars
standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days
express shipping costs 12.95 dollars and arrives in 1 to 2 business days
orders placed before 2 pm Pacific ship the same business day
shipping-info.text: Standard shipping is free for orders over 50 dollars and otherwise costs 4.95 dollars. Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days. Express shipping costs 12.95 dollars and arrives in 1 to 2 business days. Orders placed before 2 pm Pacific ship the same business day.
shipping-info.title: Shipping options and timelines

facts: electronics include a 2 year warranty covering manufacturing defects
the warranty does not cover accidental damage or water damage
warranty claims can be filed from the account orders page
warranty-info.text: All electronics include a 2 year warranty covering manufacturing defects. The warranty does not cover accidental damage or water damage. Warranty claims can be filed from the account orders page and a prepaid return label is provided for approved claims.
warranty-info.title: Product warranty
